<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Natural Senses](/Feats.aspx?ID=5302) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 25

</column>

---

You have retained your sharp animal senses even after awakening. Choose one of the following senses appropriate to your kind of animal: [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415), echolocation 10 feet, [low-light vision](/Rules.aspx?ID=416), [scent](/Rules.aspx?ID=417) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet, or [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=82) (imprecise) 30 feet. (Echolocation allows you to use hearing as a [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) at the listed range.) If your animal kind doesn't typically have a specific type of sense, you can't gain that sense with this feat.

**Special** You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different sense each time.

<title level="2">Natural Senses leads to...</title>
[True Senses](/Feats.aspx?ID=5321)
name: Natural Senses
